$comment: Models and rates for the provider recipes: standard (short-context) pay-as-you-go prices in USD per 1M tokens, read from each source on read_at. `default` is the cheapest model of the provider that supports tool calling, except where noted; `fallback` is tried only if the default answers 404. Confirm before a paid run; the runner refuses a model that has no rates here or in RECIPE_RATES.

openai.note: Founder choice: gpt-5.4-nano, then gpt-4.1-mini, both available to the existing project key. gpt-6-luna lists cheaper (0.10 / 0.50) but is not confirmed on that key.

anthropic.note: Founder choice; also the cheapest current model. The input rate is for prompts up to 100,000 tokens (a call here stays under 80,000).

gemini.note: Cheapest paid-tier text model with function calling. Gemini 3 rates are introductory through 2026-12-31.

xai.note: Cheapest general model with function calling. grok-build-0.1 (1.00 / 2.00) is cheaper but is the coding model of Grok Build, so it is not the recipe default.

meta.note: Standard mode only (content not used for training). Muse Spark 1.3, 1.2 and 1.1 share these rates; Contributor mode is cheaper but trains on the content, so it is not used.

openrouter.note: Pass-through pricing. The plan's model (Claude Haiku 5.5) is kept so that this recipe exercises a different family from the Gemini recipe; google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite is 0.10 / 0.40. OpenRouter charges a 5.5% fee (US$0.80 minimum) on credit purchases; that is funding, not run spend.
